title: Implement panelized GF(2^m) GEMM
description:
Reduce per-output-cell scratch/export overhead with panelized multi-output GEMM.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] GF(2^m) GEMM target rows are within 1.5x of the selected reference or faster.
- [hard] The scalar fallback and existing CLMUL batch path remain correct.
